# PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic

> PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic is an evidence-based physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic in Multan, Punjab, Pakistan. Services include in-clinic physiotherapy, home visits in Multan, manual therapy, exercise rehabilitation, sports injury care, pain management, post-surgical rehabilitation and neurological rehabilitation.

## About the clinic

PainFix provides individualized physiotherapy assessment and rehabilitation for musculoskeletal pain, injuries, mobility limitations and selected neurological conditions. Treatment plans may combine education, manual therapy, therapeutic exercise and functional rehabilitation according to clinical findings and patient goals.

**Location:** Usman Raja Market, near Khair Ul Maarif School, Shalimar Colony, Multan, Punjab, Pakistan.

**Clinic hours:** Monday to Saturday, 11:00 AM–4:00 PM. Sunday by appointment.

**Confirmed fees:**
- In-clinic fee: PKR 2,000.
- Home visit fee: PKR 2,500; includes one treatment session and travel.
- Video consultation: PKR 1,000.

**Service availability:**
- In-clinic physiotherapy in Multan.
- Home physiotherapy visits in Multan, subject to service-area availability.
- Online physiotherapy consultation where clinically appropriate.

Areas of practice include musculoskeletal rehabilitation, manual therapy, exercise-based rehabilitation, back and neck pain, sciatica, posture-related concerns and functional recovery.

## Conditions and patient education

PainFix publishes general educational information about back pain, neck pain, sciatica, disc-related symptoms, frozen shoulder, knee pain, sports injuries, muscle and ligament injuries, post-surgical recovery, stroke rehabilitation, posture and mobility.

Browse the [conditions library](https://painfixphysiotherapy.com/conditions) and [patient education articles](https://painfixphysiotherapy.com/blog).

## Appointments and contact

For appointment availability, service-area confirmation and current fees, use the [appointment page](https://painfixphysiotherapy.com/book-appointment) or [contact PainFix](https://painfixphysiotherapy.com/contact).

## Service area

The clinic is based in Multan, Punjab, Pakistan. In-clinic care and home visits are provided in Multan; online consultations may be available for patients outside the local service area.

## Medical information disclaimer

Website content is for general education and does not establish a diagnosis or replace an individualized assessment. Treatment suitability depends on the patient's history, examination findings, goals and clinical presentation.
